text:
maya: Quick micro-poll: If our KV cache had a dating profile, what's the bio? I'll start:

maya: ```
Name: KV-Cache
Bio: 'Loves long token walks, hates cold starts. Prefers prefix-sharing. Will keep your secrets — for TTL.
Hobbies: batching, warm starts, collecting hot keys.'
```
jamal: LOL :joy: 'seeks respectful eviction policy. Must like caching and occasional compaction.'
alex: swipe right if you respect my LRU past :rofl:
sophia: Also, model roommate writeups: 'left a sticky note: "swapped your sandwich for a shorter context"' :sandwich:
dana_design: I'm imagining a messy Tinder card with a tiny GPU sticker :heart_eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder: don't actually change eviction policy in prod without a rollout plan :robot_face:
maya: Also bonus: what would its profile pic be? I'm voting an old librarian GIF.
jamal: GIF of a cat hitting the 'keep' button on a keyboard :cat:
alex: can we get this for the onboarding slides? 'Meet the team: our cache is secretly judging you' :thumbsup:
sophia: I'm adding a prompt: `You are a charming-but-slightly-passive-aggressive cache. Convince devs to prewarm you.`
maya: omg write sample message: "I'm not mad, I just reaped your cold start" ;)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: can confirm prewarming improves morale and P50 latency :rocket:
maya: poll results: librarian GIF wins. next week: 'model's favorite snack' :tada:
